items.title_cn: 为2026年美国中期选举做准备
items.what_happened: Anthropic概述了在2026年美国中期选举前如何加强选举保障措施。该公司利用Anthropic Insights分析了近期一周内的25万次对话。涉及政治、公共政策或社会问题的对话约占Claude.ai美国所有对话的5.75%，约0.51%的对话与选举相关。
items.what_happened_en: Anthropic outlined how it has strengthened election safeguards ahead of the 2026 US midterms. Using Anthropic Insights, it analyzed 250,000 conversations over a recent one-week period. Conversations touching on politics, public policy, or social issues account for about 5.75% of all US conversations on Claude.ai, and about 0.51% of all conversations are election-related.
items.why_it_matters: 该分析展示了AI平台在重大选举前如何大规模衡量和防止与选举相关的滥用。
items.why_it_matters_en: The analysis shows how AI platforms measure and prevent election-related misuse at scale ahead of a major election.

items.title_cn: Yandex中断：数据显示恶意机器人并未消失，而是转移了
items.title_en: Yandex outage: data shows that instead of going dark, malicious bots went on the move
items.title_original: Yandex outage: data shows that instead of going dark, malicious bots went on the move
items.what_happened: 在Yandex数据中心据报遭袭后，有说法称俄罗斯僵尸网络和影响力行动已下线。Cloudflare利用Cloudflare Radar和Bot Management数据分析了Yandex的两个ASN：AS13238用于搜索，AS200350用于云服务。两者流量均下降，但影响不同。Yandex搜索流量下降几乎全是已验证的搜索爬虫在索引网页、图片和站点资源。Yandex.Cloud的漏洞扫描和探测等恶意活动有所减少，但大规模自动化并未消失，而是迁移到了其他托管服务商。
items.what_happened_en: Following reported strikes on Yandex data centers, claims circulated that Russian bot farms and influence operations had been knocked offline. Using Cloudflare Radar and Bot Management data, Cloudflare analyzed two Yandex ASNs: AS13238 for search and AS200350 for cloud services. Both saw traffic drops, but with differing impact. The Yandex Search drop consisted almost entirely of verified search crawlers indexing web pages, images, and site resources. Yandex.Cloud saw a decline in malicious activities like vulnerability scanning and probing, but high-volume automation did not vanish; it migrated to other hosting providers.
items.why_it_matters: 分析表明，总体流量指标可能具有误导性，恶意自动化在基础设施中断期间可能迁移到其他托管服务商，而非消失。
items.why_it_matters_en: The analysis shows that aggregate traffic metrics can mislead and that malicious automation can migrate to other hosting providers rather than disappear during infrastructure disruptions.

items.title_cn: 新加坡办公室与政府谅解备忘录 | Anthropic
items.title_en: Singapore office and government MOU | Anthropic
items.title_original: Singapore office and government MOU | Anthropic
items.what_happened: Anthropic在新加坡开设了新办公室，这是其在亚太地区的第五个办公室，并与新加坡数码发展及新闻部签署了谅解备忘录。Claude已在为新加坡企业和政府服务提供支持，每天有数百万人使用，例如GovTech Singapore、Grab和DBS。
items.what_happened_en: Anthropic opened a new office in Singapore, its fifth in the Asia-Pacific region, and signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Singapore Ministry of Digital Development and Information. Claude is already powering Singaporean business and government services used by millions of people every day, like GovTech Singapore, Grab, and DBS.
items.why_it_matters: 此举扩大了Anthropic在亚太地区的业务，并正式确立了与新加坡政府在负责任AI方面的合作。
items.why_it_matters_en: The move expands Anthropic's Asia-Pacific operations and formalizes cooperation with Singapore's government on responsible AI.

items.title_cn: 研究人员改进未来两到六周的天气预报
items.title_en: Researchers improve weather forecasts looking two to six weeks out
items.title_original: Researchers improve weather forecasts looking two to six weeks out
items.what_happened: 麻省理工学院的研究人员开发了一种新的机器学习方法，在两周到六周的天气预报时间范围内打破了记录。
items.what_happened_en: MIT researchers developed a new machine-learning approach that broke records for weather forecasting for the two-to-six-week time frame.
items.why_it_matters: 它改进了重要时间范围内的天气预报。
items.why_it_matters_en: It improves weather forecasting for an important time frame.

items.title_cn: NVIDIA 宣布对英国创业生态的新投资
items.title_en: NVIDIA Announces New Investments in the UK Startup Ecosystem
items.title_original: NVIDIA Announces New Investments in the UK Startup Ecosystem
items.what_happened: NVIDIA 宣布计划对 Boltz、Foresight、Hiverge、Prima Mente 和 Riverlane 进行新投资，并提供五年 2.5 亿美元算力承诺，以加强英国智能体安全与安保研究。
items.what_happened_en: NVIDIA announced new planned investments in Boltz, Foresight, Hiverge, Prima Mente and Riverlane, and a five-year, $250 million compute commitment to strengthen the UK's agentic safety and security research.
items.why_it_matters: 这些投资扩大了英国生态系统的 AI 算力与创业支持。
items.why_it_matters_en: The investments expand AI compute and startup support in the UK ecosystem.

items.title_cn: 欧洲城市部署 NVIDIA 驱动的 AI 智能体以运行更智能的城市运营
items.title_en: European Cities Deploy NVIDIA-Powered AI Agents to Run Smarter Urban Operations
items.title_original: European Cities Deploy NVIDIA-Powered AI Agents to Run Smarter Urban Operations
items.what_happened: EMEA 地区的城市及本地软件、基础设施和集成合作伙伴正在使用 NVIDIA 加速计算构建物理 AI 智能体和数字孪生，软件合作伙伴包括 ABA Technology、Akila、Galene AI、Honeywell Technologies、K2K、Linker Vision、Milestone、Onetera、ThinkDeep 和 Younite AI，为城市运营和公共服务开发解决方案。
items.what_happened_en: Cities and local software, infrastructure and integration partners across the EMEA region are using NVIDIA accelerated computing to build physical AI agents and digital twins, with software partners including ABA Technology, Akila, Galene AI, Honeywell Technologies, K2K, Linker Vision, Milestone, Onetera, ThinkDeep and Younite AI developing solutions for city operations and public services.
items.why_it_matters: 这些部署显示 AI 智能体正进入现实世界的城市运营和公共服务。
items.why_it_matters_en: The deployments show AI agents moving into real-world urban operations and public services.

items.title_cn: 三星扩展 Galaxy 上 AI 体验的语言支持
items.title_en: Samsung Expands Language Support Across AI Experiences on Galaxy
items.title_original: Samsung Expands Language Support Across AI Experiences on Galaxy - Samsung Global Newsroom
items.what_happened: 三星正在扩展 Galaxy AI 和 Bixby 的语言支持。Call Assist、Note Assist、Interpreter 和 Transcript Assist 现在包括匈牙利语和马来语，使 Live Translate 支持 24 种语言。
items.what_happened_en: Samsung is expanding language support for Galaxy AI and Bixby. Call Assist, Note Assist, Interpreter, and Transcript Assist now include Hungarian and Malay, bringing Live Translate to 24 languages.
items.why_it_matters: 它让更多用户以自己的语言体验 AI。
items.why_it_matters_en: It brings AI experiences to more users in their own language.
